record.title: Restricted isometry property for the random scattering matrix
record.statement: Establish the so-called restricted isometry property for the structured random scattering matrix $A$ defined in (5) on PDF page 43.

record.title: Entire-version conjecture for Harris–Taylor perverse sheaves
record.statement:
Let $\pi_v$ be an irreducible cuspidal representation of $\mathrm{GL}_g(F_v)$ such that its modular reduction is supercuspidal. Then, for all $1\le t\le s=\left\lfloor\frac{d}{g}\right\rfloor$, one has
\[
{}^p j^{\ge tg}_{!*}\,\mathcal F_{\overline{\mathbb Z}_\ell}(\pi_v,t)[d-tg]
\;\simeq\;
{}^{p+}j^{\ge tg}_{!*}\,\mathcal F_{\overline{\mathbb Z}_\ell}(\pi_v,t)[d-tg].
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2012/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12004), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bounds for Dirichlet eigenvalues
record.statement:
Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^{m+1}$ be a bounded domain with smooth boundary $\Sigma=\partial\Omega$. Is it possible to obtain a bound of the form
\[
\lambda_k(\Sigma)\operatorname{Vol}(\Sigma)^{2/m}\le A_m I(\Omega)+B_m k^{2/m}
\]
for all $k\ge 1$?

record.title: Optimal power in upper bounds for the Steklov spectrum

record.title: Diameter of two glued random polygon triangulations
record.statement: Let $T_1,T_2$ be two independent and uniformly random triangulations of an $n$-gon (without internal vertices). Glue these triangulations together along the boundary $n$-gon to form a triangulation (in the generalized sense) of the $2$-sphere. What is the typical or expected diameter of the resulting graph, in the graph metric? It is conjectured to be of order $n^{1/4+o(1)}$.

record.title: Classification of bicycle $(n,k)$-gons
record.statement: An equilateral plane $n$-gon $V_1V_2\ldots V_n$ is called a bicycle $(n,k)$-gon if, for all $i$, the quadrilateral $V_iV_{i+1}V_{i+k}V_{i+k+1}$ is an isosceles trapezoid: $V_iV_{i+k+1}$ is parallel to $V_{i+1}V_{i+k}$ and $|V_iV_{i+k}|=|V_{i+1}V_{i+k+1}|$, where $2\le k\le n/2$. For which pairs $(n,k)$ is the regular polygon the only bicycle $(n,k)$-gon?

record.title: Representations by a constrained quadratic form $Q_5$
record.statement:
For every integer $n\ge 1$ with $n\notin\{1,2,3,6\}$, there exist $x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4$ satisfying $x_j\in\mathbb Z+\frac{j}{5}$ for $1\le j\le 4$, $\max_{j\ne k}\frac{x_j}{x_k}\le 2$, and
\[
Q_5(x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4)=2\sum_{j=1}^{4}x_j^2-\sum_{1\le j<k\le 4}x_jx_k=n.
\]

record.title: Numerical semigroups and 5-core partitions of every size at least 6
record.statement: For each integer $n\ge 6$, there exists a numerical semigroup $S$ with multiplicity $5$ and $w(S)+g(S)=n$. record.title: Approximation conjecture for first Betti numbers in arbitrary characteristic
record.statement:
Let $G$ be finitely presented. For every inverse system $(G_i)_{i\in I}$ of normal subgroups of $G$, directed by inclusion, with $[G:G_i]<\infty$ for all $i\in I$ and $\bigcap_{i\in I}G_i=\{1\}$, and for every field $K$, does the limit
$$
\lim_{i\in I}\frac{b_1(G_i;K)}{[G:G_i]}
$$
exist and remain independent of the choice of the system $(G_i)_{i\in I}$ and of the field $K$?

record.title: Critical values in the genus-four Hassett–Keel program
record.statement: In the remaining interval $\alpha\in\left(\frac{5}{9},\frac{2}{3}\right)$ of the genus-four Hassett–Keel program, there are exactly two further critical values, namely $\alpha=\frac{19}{29}$ and $\alpha=\frac{49}{83}$ (as predicted by Alper–Fedorchuk–Smyth).

record.title: Classification of connected components of quadratic-differential strata in genera 3 and 4
record.statement:
Besides the hyperelliptic strata, the strata $Q_g(d_1,\ldots,d_k)$ are connected except for

- $Q_3(9,-1)$, $Q_3(6,3,-1)$, and $Q_3(3,3,3,-1)$; and
- $Q_4(12)$, $Q_4(9,3)$, $Q_4(6,6)$, $Q_4(6,3,3)$, and $Q_4(3,3,3,3)$.

Each exceptional stratum has two connected components, distinguished by the parity of $\dim H^0\!\left(X,\mathcal O_X\left(\operatorname{div}_0(q)/3\right)\right)$.

record.title: Equality of the small-intensity threshold and the vacant-set critical parameter
record.statement:
For the vacant set $V^u$ of random interlacements on $\mathbb{Z}^d$ with $d\ge 3$, let $u^*$ be the percolation critical parameter and let $\bar u$ be the supremum of intensities $u'$ for which the two macroscopic-connectivity estimates in Definition 2 hold uniformly at all $u\in(0,u')$. Is
\[
\bar u=u^*?
\]

record.title: Intensity of loop-erased random walk at $(1,0)$ on the square lattice
record.statement:
For the loop-erased random walk on $\Z^2$ from $(0,0)$ to infinity, the probability that its path passes through $(1,0)$ is
$$
\mathbb{P}\bigl((1,0)\text{ lies on the LERW from }(0,0)\text{ to }\infty\bigr)=\frac{5}{16}.
$$

record.title: Arone–Turchin model for spaces of long embeddings
record.statement:
For all positive integers $m,n$ with $n>m+2$, there is a weak homotopy equivalence
\[
\operatorname{Emb}_c(\mathbb{R}^m,\mathbb{R}^n)\simeq \operatorname{Map}^{h}_{\mathrm{LBimod}_{B_m}}(B_m,B_n),
\]
where $B_m$ and $B_n$ are the operads of little $m$- and $n$-balls, respectively, and $\operatorname{Map}^{h}$ denotes the derived mapping space of linear $B_m$-bimodules.

record.title: Infinite-dimensionality of the Fomin–Kirillov algebras
record.statement:
For an integer $n\ge 3$, let $E_n$ be the algebra generated by $x_{(ij)}$ for $1\le i<j\le n$, with relations
\[
x_{(ij)}^2=0,
\]
\[
x_{(ij)}x_{(jk)}=x_{(jk)}x_{(ik)}+x_{(ik)}x_{(ij)},\qquad
x_{(jk)}x_{(ij)}=x_{(ik)}x_{(jk)}+x_{(ij)}x_{(ik)}
\]
for $1\le i<j<k\le n$, and
\[
x_{(ij)}x_{(kl)}=x_{(kl)}x_{(ij)}
\]
for pairwise distinct $i,j,k,l$. Is $\dim E_n=\infty$ for every $n\ge 6$?

record.title: Contact structure on the link of a mixed homogeneous covering lift
record.statement:
Assume that $f(z)$ is a convenient non-degenerate holomorphic function and let $g=\cphi_{a,b}^{*}f$ be its mixed homogeneous covering lift, where
\[
\phi_{a,b}(w,\bar w)=(w_1^a\bar w_1^b,\ldots,w_n^a\bar w_n^b).
\]
Assume $a>b>0$ and define the link
\[
K_r=g^{-1}(0)\cap S_r.
\]
Then there exists $r_0>0$ such that $K_r$ is a contact submanifold of $S_r$ for every $r$ with $0<r\le r_0$.

record.title: Isotropic constant conjecture (hyperplane conjecture)

record.title: The Busemann–Petty problem for central sections of origin-symmetric convex bodies

\[
\operatorname{Vol}_n(K)\le \operatorname{Vol}_n(L)?

record.title: Uniform VC*-density bounds from the one-variable case
record.statement: Assume $T$ has NIP. Assume there is $k$ such that for all formulas $\varphi(x;y)$ with $\ell(x)=1$ we have $\operatorname{vc}^{*}(\varphi)\leq k$. Is it true that for all $n$ there is $k(n)$ such that $\operatorname{vc}^{*}(\varphi(x;y))\leq k(\ell(x))$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/01](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12329), page 18. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Albertson’s precoloring-extension conjecture for planar graphs
record.statement: There exists a constant $D$ such that the following holds: if $G$ is a plane graph with a $5$-list-assignment $L$ and $X\subseteq V(G)$ satisfies $d(u,v)\ge D$ for all distinct $u,v\in X$, then every $L$-coloring of $X$ extends to an $L$-coloring of $G$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12330), page 16. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Gyárfás–Sumner conjecture in heroic-set form
record.statement: For every complete graph $K$ and every tree $T$, the set $\{K,T\}$ is heroic.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12330), page 24. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Ramsey goodness of hypercubes
record.statement: For every integer $s\ge 1$, is the family of hypercubes $\{Q_n\}_{n\ge 1}$ $s$-good? Here $Q_n$ has vertex set $\{0,1\}^n$, with two vertices adjacent exactly when they differ in one coordinate, and $s$-good means that, for all sufficiently large $n$, $r(Q_n,K_s)=(|Q_n|-1)(s-1)+1=(2^n-1)(s-1)+1$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2013/02](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/12330), page 25. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
